entities.name: Lia
entities.description: A young girl from a village in Bant with curled fingers who can make rocks crumble.

entities.name: Cele
entities.description: A young wife of one of the missing hunters.

entities.name: Knight Aran
entities.description: A brave knight in Lia's imagined story about the siege of Eos Castle.

entities.name: Eos Castle
entities.description: A Bant castle besieged by undead in the elders' tales and Lia's game.

entities.name: Lia's village
entities.description: A ragtag village built among the ruins of a castle in Bant.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A vast realm of floating castles and lush grass, remade by the Conflux.

entities.name: Conflux
entities.description: The merging of Alara that remade the landscape and began years of torment and war.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: Shard whose undead hordes feature in tales of Bant.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: Shard where the Sculptor crafted bodies from etherium.

entities.name: The Sculptor
entities.description: An old man who serves Nefarox and builds a ritual site from bones of a hellkite.

entities.name: Nefarox
entities.description: The Sculptor's master, who slumbers in the tunnels below the arena.

entities.name: Matca arena
entities.description: A massive arena where Nayan humans once fought for sport, now the worksite.

events.summary: Lia makes a pebble crumble with magic.
events.quote: there was a popping noise, and the pebble crumbled on her knuckle.

events.summary: Girls mock Lia in the village the day before.
events.quote: Even girls she thought of as friends joined in to mock Lia

events.summary: Lia spots a spotted-fur creature watching from a tree.
events.quote: she glimpsed someone perched on a tree branch, hidden among the leaves.

events.summary: Two village hunters go missing and a search party is formed.
events.quote: two of the village hunters were missing, and her father and brother joined a search party

events.summary: Lia tells her mother she saw a cat-faced creature.
events.quote: I saw a thing that had a cat face but a body like us

events.summary: Lia is abducted behind her cottage by cat-faced captors.
events.quote: As a dark bag fell across her eyes, she glimpsed a cat-like face.

events.summary: A demon appears over the village, sickening the villagers while servants encircle it.
events.quote: Just as the crimson sun disappeared behind the unnatural mountains, the demon seemed to materialize in the starry sky.
By morning, a sickly wind blew through the open door of Lia's cottage, which was as empty as the rest of the village.

events.summary: The Sculptor surveys his work for Nefarox.
events.quote: The Sculptor surveyed his work with a critical eye.

events.summary: The Sculptor recalls crafting etherium bodies in Esper.
events.quote: He had crafted bodies from etherium in Esper before he realized his work had been a perverted lie.

events.summary: New recruits from Bant are marched into the arena.
events.quote: Bant humans from the grasslands, probably that miserable little village near the ruined castle.

events.summary: The count of bodies reaches forty-nine and the Sculptor finds the ritual's numbers aligned.
events.quote: Forty-seven bodies. Plus the two hunters they'd caught spying on them earlier. Forty-nine bodies.

events.summary: The Sculptor realizes the ritual will take place tonight.
events.quote: It was perfect. And after such a long wait, it would be tonight.

events.summary: The Conflux reshaped Bant, raising an unnatural mountain range.
events.quote: An unnatural mountain range had clawed its way out of the earth and forever blocked passage to the sea.

relations.quote: the breathing of his master, Nefarox, who slumbered in the tunnels below the arena
